product_overview: A lightweight React app to search, simulate booking, and review hotels and flights using in-memory data and a hardcoded test account. The app provides user authentication, search, booking history, reviews, and an admin interface for in-session content management.
core_goals: Allow users to authenticate with a simple test account and access protected routes.
Enable searching and simulated booking of hotels and flights using local mock data.
Allow users to submit and view reviews for hotels and flights.
Provide a booking history view showing user bookings from the current session.
Offer an admin interface to add and remove hotels/flights in-memory for demo purposes.
Keep the app simple to run locally with no external services or persistent backend.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to sign in with email and password (test account example@gmail.com / 123456789) to access protected areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field with example@gmail.com -> Fill password input field with 123456789 -> Click Sign In button to submit -> Redirect to /search on success -> See /search page

Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field with wrong@example.com -> Fill password input field with wrongpass -> Click Sign In button to submit -> See error message on invalid credentials -> Stay on /login
Navigate to /search while unauthenticated -> Redirect to /login -> See /login page

features.name: Search Hotels and Flights
features.description: Search local hotels by location or flights by origin/destination, view results, and simulate bookings which show success/failure feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to /search -> Switch between Hotels and Flights tabs -> Fill search by location with New York (Hotels) -> View list of hotels -> Click Book Now on a hotel card -> See snackbar success message and booking added to session data

Navigate to /search -> Switch to Flights tab -> Fill From field with JFK -> Fill To field with LAX -> View list of flights -> Click Book Flight on a flight card -> See snackbar success message and booking added to session data

Navigate to /search -> Switch between Hotels and Flights tabs -> Fill search fields incompletely or with invalid input -> Click Book Now or Book Flight -> See snackbar failure or validation message -> Booking not added
Navigate to /search while unauthenticated -> Redirect to /login -> See /login page

features.name: Booking History
features.description: Show the user's bookings created during the current session and an appropriate empty state when none exist.
user_flows: Navigate to /history -> See list of bookings pulled from session/mock data -> Inspect booking details
Navigate to /history when there are no bookings -> See empty state message indicating no bookings
Navigate to /history while unauthenticated -> Redirect to /login -> See /login page

features.name: Reviews
features.description: Allow users to select a hotel or flight, set a rating and comment, post the review, and see the refreshed recent reviews list.
user_flows: Navigate to /reviews -> Switch between Hotels and Flights tabs -> Select hotel or flight from dropdown -> Set rating with Rating component -> Fill comment textarea -> Click Post Review to submit -> See snackbar and refreshed reviews list
Navigate to /reviews -> Select a hotel or flight -> Leave rating unset or comment empty -> Click Post Review to submit -> See validation error or snackbar failure -> Review not posted
Navigate to /reviews while unauthenticated -> Redirect to /login -> See /login page

features.name: Admin Content Management
features.description: In-memory admin UI to add new hotels or flights and remove existing ones for demo/content management within the current session.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Switch between Hotels and Flights tabs -> Fill Add New Hotel form fields -> Click submit -> See new hotel in list and snackbar success message (item stored in-memory)
Navigate to /admin -> Switch to Flights tab -> Fill Add New Flight form fields incompletely -> Click submit -> See validation error -> New flight not added
Navigate to /admin -> Locate a hotel or flight card in the list -> Click Remove on a hotel or flight card -> See item removed from list and snackbar success message
Navigate to /admin while unauthenticated -> Redirect to /login -> See /login page

features.name: Booking Page Placeholder
features.description: A placeholder booking page route that indicates booking details are not implemented and prevents completing a real booking flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /booking -> See placeholder message indicating booking page is not implemented
From /search click Book Now or Book Flight -> Redirect to /booking -> See placeholder message and inability to complete booking -> See notification that booking flow is not implemented
Navigate to /booking while unauthenticated -> Redirect to /login -> See /login page
